Digital Freedom Contest: Submissions

👏 We would like to thank each contestant for their input – you are all amazing! More than 1,000 links were submitted, already drawing over 67.2M views. That is the population of a large country – reached, thanks to you, with the idea of digital freedom.

🎬 We will open all submissions on contest.com in the coming days – watch for a separate announcement here. Judging is already underway; results are expected by the end of August.

text:
🏆 Digital Freedom Contest: Clarifications and Submissions

We are glad to provide clarifications regarding the numerous similar questions we received:

Q: How many videos can be submitted?
A: You can submit multiple videos across different platforms – e.g., 3 separate videos for X and 2 for TikTok – or one video for each qualifying platform (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat or X), provided each separate video gained at least 10,000 views. Videos that gained fewer than 10,000 views will not be accepted for the competition and will not be eligible for a share of the prize fund.

Note: Videos we deem low-quality or suspect of having generated non-organic views will be excluded.

Q: When will submissions open, and how can I send my video(s)?
A: We will post a separate message in this channel in the coming days, once @ContestBot begins accepting submissions. You will have at least several days to submit your work, so do not worry – you will not miss it.

Note: @ContestBot is the only tool you will use to submit your work.

Q: I'm worried that my video will be stolen and submitted by someone else.
A: You must include your Telegram @username in the caption of the video on the external platform. This username must match the @username of the account from which you will submit the video. Videos that does not have a proper @username caption, will be discarded from the evaluation.

text:
🏆 Digital Freedom Contest

Prize Fund: $200,000
Deadline: July 15, 23:59 Dubai time
Results: August 2026

📱 Telegram is launching its most ambitious contest for content creators.

The Task
Create a viral video about digital freedom, post it on one of these platforms — TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat Spotlights or X — and get 10,000+ authentic views.

Requirements and Conditions
– You must use at least some ideas and footage from Pavel Durov's speech;
– You may add any other media and ideas to promote digital freedom;
– You may submit multiple videos across multiple platforms.
– You may use any language and any tools to create your video.

Evaluation Criteria
Videos we deem low-quality or suspect of having generated non-organic views will be excluded. All other qualifying videos will be eligible for a share of the prize fund.

Submissions
We will publish instructions on how to submit links to your videos on July 6 in this channel.

Good luck! 🤞

linkPreview.description:
He built platforms to protect speech when speaking freely became dangerous.

At the Oslo Freedom Forum, Pavel Durov shares how Telegram emerged from a commitment to free expression and why defending digital freedom is central to protecting human rights today.…

Design Contest 2026, Round 2: Submissions

Reminder: only those who secured 🥈2nd or 🥉3rd places in Round 1 will be able to submit their work.

ContestBot will begin accepting your submissions during the next 24 hours – you will be able to submit your work by 23:59 Dubai Time on May 18th, 2026.

Similar to Round 1, your submission must include:
– A link to either a private or public channel, with all relevant media posted for each feature you propose improvements for. You are kindly advised to not reuse your old channels.
– A .zip archive with your static mockups (.png) and animated demos (if applicable).

Note: Your channel may stay private until the deadline. Make sure you assign it a username after the deadline. We will discard private channels from the evaluation.
